opportunities.title: Find the invoice mistakes that distort a restaurant’s food costs
opportunities.summary: A restaurant receives supplier invoices with inconsistent descriptions, pack sizes and occasional extraction errors. Give the owner an exception inbox showing which cost changes need checking and the original evidence behind each flag.
opportunities.audience: Independent restaurant operators and their bookkeepers
opportunities.buyer: Owner or bookkeeper responsible for reconciling supplier costs
flow: Check duplicates, pack sizes and price changes
opportunities.deliverable: An interactive invoice exception inbox with an auditable correction history
opportunities.question: Can an exception-first review reduce checking time without hiding genuine invoice errors?
opportunities.measure: Known-error recall, false flags per invoice and correction time against a spreadsheet on a clearly labelled fixture set; real usefulness requires an operator trial.
opportunities.baseline: Mindee already extracts invoice line items; xtraCHEF already offers restaurant invoice automation. A generic OCR app would duplicate existing products.
opportunities.proposed_difference: Test a lightweight, locally processed exception review for operators who cannot justify a full purchasing platform. This segment and gap are hypotheses.
opportunities.risk: Stop if operators already solve this cheaply, cannot supply consented examples, or correction time exceeds spreadsheet review. Do not promise accounting accuracy.
opportunities.data_plan: Week one: bundled synthetic invoices and editable extracted CSV/JSON. Later: consented, redacted Swedish supplier invoices; no scraping private documents.
opportunities.model_plan: Rules for totals and duplicate rows; optional small pretrained text embeddings for product matching only after exact matching baseline. PDF OCR is a later extension.
opportunities.why_ml: Matching varied supplier descriptions may benefit from embeddings; arithmetic and duplicate checks should use rules.
opportunities.venture: Potential narrow food-operations product or managed onboarding service; recurring value would come from verified cost history, not one-off OCR.
opportunities.customer_test: Owner can test the inbox with two local operators/bookkeepers and ask which flags change an actual purchasing or correction decision.
opportunities.week_test: In 4–6 days build CSV import, seeded duplicate/pack-size cases, side-by-side source view, corrections and export. No bank/POS integration or automated supplier disputes.
opportunities.growth_path: Exception inbox → supplier-specific matching learned from corrections → repeatable onboarding for small operators.
opportunities.evidence: A vendor feedback report describes duplicated extracted rows (search-index evidence; full page fetch timed out). Vendor material describes line-item and restaurant review problems. These are biased, limited signals, not validated local demand.
opportunities.evidence_level: User report + vendor evidence; local demand untested
opportunities.market: Evidence review pending; no automatic build

opportunities.title: Can a defect detector survive a change of lighting?
opportunities.summary: Adapt pretrained visual features to a small inspection task, then test when lighting changes make the detector unreliable.
opportunities.deliverable: A small-data robustness study with explicit failure boundaries
opportunities.question: Does threshold calibration or limited adaptation improve reliability under lighting shift at a fixed false-alarm budget?
opportunities.measure: Image-level AUROC, recall at fixed false-alarm rate, calibration, inference time; split by acquisition condition.
opportunities.baseline: Frozen features + nearest-neighbour anomaly score; simple image statistics; an existing Anomalib baseline.
opportunities.alternative: Frozen features + nearest-neighbour anomaly score; simple image statistics; an existing Anomalib baseline.
opportunities.proposed_difference: A controlled comparison of adaptation and calibration under predefined lighting shifts and label budgets—not a recreation of the benchmark.
opportunities.risk: Prior work may already answer the question; industrial images do not establish performance on a customer’s production line.
opportunities.data_plan: Inspect one MVTec AD 2 public subset. Verify dataset terms before downloading; commercial reuse is not assumed.
opportunities.model_plan: Pretrained vision backbone; frozen features first, a small adapter only if feasible.
opportunities.why_ml: Visual variability is hard to encode with fixed thresholds, but simple statistics may still win.
opportunities.venture: Possible service: adapt and validate inspection models on customer-owned images. No willingness-to-pay evidence yet.
opportunities.contribution: A small-data robustness study with explicit failure boundaries
opportunities.feasibility: Start with a small public-data feasibility check on the laptop. Record licences, memory and runtime before scaling; no paid compute.
opportunities.next: Write a feasibility brief, verify closest papers, inspect data access and design a leakage-safe pilot. Do not conduct the full thesis.
opportunities.reason: Fits task-specific applied AI; compare against simpler alternatives before committing.
opportunities.evidence: Technical starting points are verified below. Customer interviews, commercial rights and novelty checks are still outstanding.

opportunities.title: Can a sound model recognise your machine in a noisy room?
opportunities.summary: Use pretrained audio features and a small classifier; investigate transfer across microphones or recording environments.
flow: Evaluate on a different recording setup
opportunities.deliverable: A transfer-learning feasibility study with leakage-safe splits
opportunities.question: How does a frozen audio representation compare with acoustic features when the recording environment changes?
opportunities.measure: Macro F1, per-class recall, unseen-condition error and CPU latency; never split overlapping clips across train and test.
opportunities.baseline: MFCC features + logistic regression; frozen YAMNet embeddings + linear head.
opportunities.alternative: MFCC features + logistic regression; frozen YAMNet embeddings + linear head.
opportunities.proposed_difference: Compare label budgets and recording-condition transfer for one accessible task; the tutorial’s training pipeline is prior work.
opportunities.risk: Without recording-condition metadata, a claimed domain-shift study may be invalid. Environmental recognition is not fault diagnosis.
opportunities.data_plan: First find a suitably licensed audio dataset with device/session metadata; if unavailable, narrow the question before committing.
opportunities.model_plan: YAMNet embeddings with a small supervised head; no speech LLM.
opportunities.why_ml: A small acoustic model can map sound patterns to bounded labels; a fixed amplitude threshold is the minimum baseline.
opportunities.audience: Equipment-service teams or consumer device builders
opportunities.venture: Possible customer-specific sound recognition service; need an actual use case and acceptable false-alarm cost.
opportunities.contribution: A transfer-learning feasibility study with leakage-safe splits

opportunities.title: When does a pretrained forecast beat a simple local model?
opportunities.summary: Compare pretrained forecasting with small locally trained models when each business has only a short history.
opportunities.deliverable: A data-budget and transfer study for one forecasting task
opportunities.question: Under what history length and shift conditions does a pretrained forecaster outperform seasonal and tabular baselines?
opportunities.measure: Rolling-origin MASE/MAE, interval coverage, inference cost; hold out both future time and entities where possible.
opportunities.baseline: Seasonal naive; moving average; gradient boosting with lag features; frozen Chronos baseline.
opportunities.alternative: Seasonal naive; moving average; gradient boosting with lag features; frozen Chronos baseline.
opportunities.proposed_difference: A preregistered comparison across history budgets and unseen entities, with compute-normalised results. A novelty check is required.
opportunities.risk: Public retail data may poorly represent a small restaurant; pretrained training-data overlap must be investigated.
opportunities.data_plan: Find an accessible demand dataset with entity and time identifiers; check licence and any pretrained overlap before finalising the study.
opportunities.model_plan: Small Chronos variant if local resources permit; task-specific lag-feature model as a serious competitor.
opportunities.why_ml: Demand has repeatable temporal structure; complex models must justify themselves against seasonal averages.
opportunities.venture: Possible tailored forecasting and monitoring service. Savings and customer willingness to share sales data remain untested.
opportunities.contribution: A data-budget and transfer study for one forecasting task

opportunities.title: Which examples are worth asking a business to label?
opportunities.summary: Study how to choose training examples when expert labels are expensive and the model must work on a new customer’s data.
flow: Compare learning at equal label cost
opportunities.deliverable: A bounded active-learning evaluation on one task
opportunities.question: Does uncertainty-based sampling outperform random selection once class imbalance and domain shift are controlled?
opportunities.measure: Performance versus label budget, minority recall and annotation effort; multiple seeds and a fixed untouched test set.
opportunities.baseline: Random sampling and class-balanced sampling using the same frozen representation and classifier.
opportunities.alternative: Random sampling and class-balanced sampling using the same frozen representation and classifier.
opportunities.proposed_difference: Study when a simple selection policy fails or helps under explicit label costs; do not claim a new active-learning algorithm.
opportunities.risk: A generic benchmark reproduction is insufficient for a thesis; a concrete task and literature gap must be established.
opportunities.data_plan: Reuse one feasible vision or sound dataset after checking labels, split design and permitted use.
opportunities.model_plan: Frozen pretrained features plus compact classifier; simple uncertainty sampling.
opportunities.why_ml: ML can prioritise ambiguous samples, but random or balanced sampling may be equally effective.
opportunities.audience: Businesses with limited expert labelling time
opportunities.venture: Possible model-customisation service with efficient data collection. Demand and annotation costs need customer evidence.

findings: Collector fetches public metadata, not full papers or discussion resolutions. This is suitable for leads, not recommendations.
